projects.name: Health and Beauty plus
projects.description: developed a fully responsive e-commerce platform using React.js, focused on delivering an engaging shopping experience. This project features a clean and user-friendly interface, allowing users to effortlessly browse and filter a diverse selection of products.

projects.name: Eventful
projects.description: I developed an event ticket booking platform that enables users to effortlessly sign up for events, manage their registrations, and receive a unique barcode as proof of attendance. This project integrates a user-friendly interface with robust backend functionality, ensuring a seamless experience from registration to event entry.

projects.name: Finance Tracker
projects.description: A CSC420(Software Enginnering) project that allows users to track their income and expenses, providing insights into their financial habits. Users can add, edit, and delete transactions, and view a summary of their financial status.

projects.name: Campus Guard
projects.description: A security management system designed to enhance safety in the university of ilorin, kwara state, Nigeria. The platform allows both autheticated users and anonymous user to report incidents, ensuring a secure environment for all University of ilorin students.

projects.name: Social Media Micro-service API
projects.description: A nodejs project to understand how the micro-service architecture works. The project is a social media API that allows authenticated user to post contents and media. RabbitMQ was used for message queuing and express-http-proxy was used to handle the proxy for each service to the api-gateway.
